lines.en: The quiz was leaking its answers.
The Naming Office is where you make up fake names.
enLines: where you make up fake names.

lines.ko: 진짜 단지와 비슷한 이름이면 안내가 떴습니다.
lines.en: If a name was close to a real complex, it warned.
enLines: to a real complex, it warned.

lines.en: For fake names, only an exact match warned.

lines.ko: 퀴즈 이름에 '동'을 붙이면 진짜만 안내가 떴습니다.
lines.en: Add one syllable to a quiz name, and only real ones warned.
enLines: Add one syllable to a quiz name,

lines.en: That way, I got all 30 questions right.

lines.ko: 이제 진짜와 가짜를 같은 기준으로 비교합니다.
lines.en: Now real and fake names are checked the same way.
lines.art: a balance scale holding two identical blocks perfectly level

lines.ko: 다시 해 보니 절반도 못 맞혔습니다.
lines.en: Trying again, I got fewer than half right.
enLines: I got fewer than half right.

lines.en: A weekly check now measures the real-fake split.

lines.ko: 월요일 아침, 첫 점검이 저절로 돕니다.
lines.en: On Monday morning, the first check runs itself.

failCard.title: 퀴즈 답이 새고 있었다
failCard.beforeEn: One added syllable split real from fake
failCard.afterEn: Both are compared the same way

captions.ko: 작명소를 모두에게 열자마자, 이름 뒤에 '동' 한 글자만 붙이면 퀴즈 답이 보이는 구멍을 찾았습니다. 그 방법으로 30문제를 다 맞혔고, 고친 뒤엔 절반도 못 맞혔습니다.
captions.en: Right after opening the Naming Office to everyone, I found that adding one syllable to a quiz name revealed the answer. I got all 30 right that way, and after the fix, fewer than half.
